title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.

title: Chanda
desc: Kariya, a poor man, lives with his mother who works as a maid. Problems arise when he beats up the son of a rich gangster from the village while defending his life.

title: Habba
desc: A dark secret from Seetha's past keeps her from marrying Ram, her lover. Luckily for the couple, Ram's brothers are determined to get them back together.

title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a moneylender. However, tables turn when she loses her property, and they fall in love.
